instructorsData.name: Mikael
instructorsData.bio: Mikael has been teaching for over 8 years and is the founder of Fuego Dance School. He has a passion for technical precision and helping students build a strong foundation.
instructorsData.experience: 10+ years of teaching and competing in Bachata

instructorsData.name: Irina
instructorsData.bio: With a background in ballet and contemporary dance, Irina focuses on building musicality, fluidity, and confidence. She leads all styling and choreography classes.
instructorsData.experience: 8 years of professional dance and teaching

instructorsData.name: Jennifer
instructorsData.bio: A dynamic duo known for their pedagogy and fun classes. They specialize in making complex moves accessible to the intermediate level.
instructorsData.experience: 6 years teaching together as a couple
achievements: Known for breaking down complex moves

instructorsData.name: Andris
